# pve_ceph (Data Source)

Ceph endpoint indexes: the cluster-wide and the per-node API surface.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_ceph" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_index` (String) Raw JSON payload returned by /cluster/ceph (the API schema does not describe its shape).
- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>.
- `node_index` (String) Raw JSON payload returned by /nodes/{node}/ceph (the API schema does not describe its shape).
